widgets_values:
## Необходимо 6-8 GB видеопамяти

## Видео на YouTube и VK

Workflow собран на основе "UltraTex · Standard (6 views + PBR)" и "UltraTex · Advanced (10 views + PBR)" от PixelArtistry + свой мультивид

Ноды от visualbruno (ComfyUI-UltraTex, MIT) и city96 (ComfyUI-GGUF, Apache-2.0), модель от UltraTex team (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), FLUX.2 Klein - Black Forest Labs

### Лицензия
- код UltraTex и ноды visualbruno — MIT, ComfyUI-GGUF — Apache-2.0
- Модели FLUX.2 Klein base 9B и Klein 9B — FLUX Non-Commercial License v2.1: результаты можно использовать для любых целей, включая коммерческие, кроме обучения конкурирующей модели; запуск самой модели — некоммерческий, перед работой на клиента проверить инфо: https://github.com/black-forest-labs/flux2/blob/main/model_licenses/LICENSE-FLUX-NON-COMMERICAL

Если запустить этот workflow после 3D-Texturing_GGUF: Prep падает, нужен перезапуск ComfyUI

nodes.title: left (дорисовка): промпт
widgets_values: Complete the painting of image 1. Image 1 shows the object seen exactly from its left side, with its front pointing to the right: the painted areas are already correct and must stay exactly as they are; only the gray areas are unpainted. Image 2 shows the same object from the front and image 3 from the back; they are color references only. Paint the gray areas so that colors, shapes and patterns continue seamlessly from the painted areas, matching the object in images 2 and 3. Every part keeps the color it has in images 2 and 3. No gray remains anywhere. Do not add any new letters, words or logos: text appears only where it is already painted in image 1. Keep the exact silhouette, pose, proportions and framing of image 1, one single figure. Smooth surface, flat, evenly lit colors, no shading, no shadows, no highlights. Pure white background.
